name: FLA_PAYMENT_LINES_INT
description: FLA_PAYMENT_LINES_INT contains the payment lines information like start date, end date, first payment date, payment line type, amount etc

columns.name: INTERFACE_PAYMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Interface Payment Line identifier. This column consistutes primary key along with LOAD_REQUEST_ID column of the table.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle Enterprise Scheduler: request identifier of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: INTERFACE_PAYMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Interface Payment header identifier. Payment header to which the payment line belongs to.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LEASE_ID
columns.description: Interface Lease identifier. It is referenced from FLA_LEASES_INT table to indicate that the payment lines are pertaining to specific lease.

columns.name: PAYMENT_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Payment line number. It is a number sequence unique within the lease payment header

columns.name: PAYMENT_LINE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the payment line starts.

columns.name: PAYMENT_LINE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the payment line ends.

columns.name: FIRST_PAYMENT_DATE
columns.description: The first payment date for the payment line

columns.name: NO_OF_PAYMENTS
columns.description: Number of payments to happen based on the effective dates and frequency. This should be empty in case the stub flag is set to Yes.

columns.name: STUB_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment line is for one-time payment for specific period or for regular payment.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated payment amount in the payment currency.

columns.name: ESTIMATED_FUNC_CURR_AMOUNT
columns.description: Estimated payment amount in the functional currency.

columns.name: ACTUAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payment amount in the payment currency

columns.name: ACTUAL_FUNC_CURR_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payment amount in the functional currency

columns.name: ASSESSABLE_VALUE
columns.description: User-enterable amount to be used as taxable basis. For future use.

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_1
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: SYSTEM_ORIGIN_REFERENCE_2
columns.description: System reference column to maintain the key of source system from which lease is being imported

columns.name: FIRST_RECURRING_START_DATE
columns.description: The earliest recurring payment line start date.

columns.name: CUMULATIVE_NUM_OF_PAYMENTS
columns.description: The cumulative number of recurring payments for the payment line.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
